d:
Just four days after being removed from his position as the Superintendent of Police (SP) of Sagar, IPS officer Anurag Sujania has resigned from service. He submitted his resignation to the state government on November 2. Following the death of 16 people in a spurious liquor incident in Banda, he had been transferred to the Police Headquarters in Bhopal as an AIG (Assistant Inspector General). He has cited personal reasons for his resignation.
